concepts.name: SpecificModels
concepts.description: models with most specific conditions that satisfy given examples.

concepts.name: GeneralModels
concepts.description: models with most general conditions that satisfy given examples

relations.name: includes
relations.description: an example is included by a model if the model satisfies the example

relations.name: consumes
relations.description: general model A is consumed by general model B if B is a generalization of A; specific model A is consumed by specific model B if B is a specification of A

relations.name: consistent
relations.description: for positive example, a model is consistent with it if it can include it; for negative example, a model is consistent with it if it doesn't include it

Assertions.name: modelsMatch
Assertions.description: Indicates that specific models and general models have matching models.

Assertions.name: modelConverged
Assertions.description: Indicates that the matching specific and general models have converged to a same condition.

Assertions.name: CurrentExampleValid
Assertions.description: Indicates that the current example is logically valid and is consistent with the concept Example properties.

Assertions.name: ModelInitialized
Assertions.description: Indicates that both the specific and general models have been initialized.

Assertions.name: SpecificModelGeneralized
Assertions.description: Indicates that generalization has been applied to the specific models to include positive example.

Assertions.name: SpecificModelGeneralized
Assertions.description: Indicates that specialization has been applied to the general models to exclude negative example.

Assertions.name: InconsistenciesRemoved
Assertions.description: Indicates that specific and general models that are not consistent with the current example have been removed.

Assertions.name: SubsumedModelsRemoved
Assertions.description: Indicates that subsumed (redundant) models have been removed from general and specific models.
